note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file (dict-based), not a callable Python module. It has no functions, classes, or methods. It inherits from a base config and overrides backbone settings to use SyncBN and ContextBlock plugins from GCNet.
review_config: review the cascade-mask-rcnn GCNet config that adds ContextBlock plugins to the X101-32x4d backbone with SyncBN
summarize_config: summarize the MMDetection config for cascade-mask-rcnn with GCNet ContextBlock on ResNeXt-101 backbone
build_model_config: build a cascade mask RCNN model config using GCNet ContextBlock with ratio 1/4 on ResNeXt-101-32x4d
refactor_backbone_plugins: refactor the backbone plugin config to change ContextBlock ratio or stage positions in the GCNet cascade-mask-rcnn setup
test_config_inheritance: test that the GCNet cascade-mask-rcnn config correctly inherits from the base cascade_rcnn config and applies SyncBN
